discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.9.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/section_18.9/cis_18.9.36.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Member Server only (from the upstream task name).

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.9.36.2 | PATCH | Ensure Restrict Unauthenticated RPC clients is set to Enabled Authenticated MS only | Member Server"
  when:
    - win19cis_rule_18_9_36_2
    - not prelim_win19cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level2-memberserver
    - rule_18.9.36.2
    - patch
    - rpc
    - NIST800-171_3.14.6
    - NIST800-171_3.14.7
    - NIST800-53R5_SI-4
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Nt\Rpc
    name: RestrictRemoteClients
    data: 1
    type: dword
